name: finance-oracle
description: Financial intelligence tool for market analysis, risk assessment and portfolio management. Provides real-time market data, financial statement analysis, credit scoring and macroeconomic indicators. Covers B3, NYSE, NASDAQ and global markets.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Returns real-time or historical price, volume and volatility data for stocks, ETFs, bonds and commodities by ticker symbol.

tools.name: analyze_financials
tools.description: Analyzes a company's financial statements returning profitability ratios, liquidity indicators, leverage metrics and valuation multiples.

tools.name: assess_credit_risk
tools.description: Evaluates credit risk for a company or individual based on financial history and macroeconomic context. Returns probability of default and recommended credit limit.
